posts.text: Excited to announce that I’ll be joining the Independent Trading Group (ITG), Inc. team this summer as a DevOps Analyst! I’m thrilled to be taking the first steps of my career at a leading independent CIRO dealer-member, where cutting-edge technology supports market making, agency execution, and innovative trading solutions across Canadian and U.S. markets. I can’t wait to learn from the experienced team at ITG and contribute to building scalable, best-in-class trading systems.
